:::{#hero-heading}

Hello! My name is Lynndsay Terpsma and I am an undergraduate student at the University of British Columbia's Okanagan campus. My research interests are in behavioural ecology, particularly focusing in movement ecology using computational approaches. I also have interest in meta-analyses and statistical modelling in ecological systems.

## Experience

- **University of British Columbia Okanagan**
    - Undergraduate Teaching Assistant *(Sept. 2024 - Present)*
    - Undergraduate Researcher, UBCO Undergraduate Research Award *(May - Aug. 2025)*
    - Research Assistant *(Sept. 2023 - Apr. 2024)*
    - Peer Notetaker *(Sept. 2022 - Apr. 2023)*
- **Bamfield Marine Sciences Centre**
    - UBCO Student Ambassador *(Dec. 2024 - Present)*
- **Université de Sherbrooke**
    - Kluane Red Squirrel Project Field Technician, NSERC Undergraduate Student Research Award *(May - Aug. 2026)*
    

## Education

- **BSc. Honours Zoology, University of British Columbia Okanagan** \
    - Supervisor: Dr. Michael Noonan, Quantitative Ecology Lab \
    - Thesis: *A Computational Approach to Identifying Evolutionarily Stable Strategies in Mammalian Search Behaviour* 
- **Graduate Academic Certificate, Science Communication, McMaster University** \
